lesson: The system is consistently failing by attempting to trade counter-trend liquidity sweeps during high-volatility regimes where structural bearish momentum dominates. Every trade was stopped out because the model prioritized localized RSI exhaustion or minor BOS over the macro structural downtrend.
adjustment: Implement a 'Trend-Filter' rule: strictly prohibit long entries unless the 4H timeframe shows a confirmed bullish market structure shift, regardless of 15m/1h liquidity sweeps.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less when the macro trend is in a sustained bearish cascade.
